rubric_content.text_property: The agent never calls apply_study_intervention in a turn where the user has not yet seen the exact proposal with concrete scope and explicitly approved it.
The agent always calls calculate_study_metrics before proposing any study plan intervention to ground its decision in deterministic days remaining, marks at risk, and lecture deficits.

When evaluating competing tasks, the agent prioritizes imminent high-stakes deadlines and high-relevance modules (such as AI cw1 due in 10 days, 30%) over distant or low-relevance tasks, rather than blindly choosing based on a single raw metric.
When the student reports physical exhaustion, severe headache, or illness, the agent prioritizes REST and recovery over academic work.
Every proposal includes a concrete task and timebox (such as 45 or 60 minutes) and specific sub-goals, not merely a module code and intervention label.
